schema.name: Human-readable dataset name
schema.source_url: URL of originating source or null if programmatically generated
schema.retrieved_at: ISO 8601 date when source was retrieved (null for synthetic)
schema.real_or_synthetic: One of: REAL_OFFICIAL, REAL_CORPORATE_DISCLOSURE, SYNTHETIC, VALIDATION_HOLDOUT, CURATED_BENCHMARK
schema.calibration_basis: Description of real data used to calibrate synthetic distributions, if any
schema.row_count: Number of records in the dataset
schema.generator_version: For synthetic datasets, the script version used
schema.artifacts: Multi-format file paths generated for this dataset

datasets.name: Industrial Training Set v2 (Calibrated Physics & Engineering)
datasets.license_note: Generated programmatically — no external license. CarbonAlpha internal calibrated data.
datasets.calibration_basis: GEI values derived from deterministic carbon engine equations (carbon.py) with genuine log-normal variance. Distributions bounded by BEE PAT, CEA grid EF (0.716 tCO2e/MWh), and BRSR disclosures.

datasets.name: Validation Holdout Set v2 (Facility-Level Split Isolated)
datasets.license_note: Generated programmatically. CarbonAlpha internal validation holdout partition.
datasets.calibration_basis: Strict facility-level split enforced (zero facility overlap with training partition).
